verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs confirm that audit logs exist. You can monitor audit logs across a group (gitlab-docs-45), and agent activities are attributed to service accounts so automated actions are identifiable in audit logs (gitlab-docs-62). Both mentions come from the AI-governance context, though, and say nothing about how broadly user and administrative actions are covered. missing for 10: explicit documentation of audit events covering user and administrative actions, instance/admin-level audit log viewing, filtering/export or API access to audit events, independent or hands-on corroboration.
